items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: We had an alto, alto and that other, what, Marley Mercy blow? He blow, he played some piano. No, he played tenor... We had a nice combination all night.

ctx.x: Yeah, what did I know to me?

Well, we had, just like trumpet and, let me see now, wait now, the piano, trumpet, bass, and the piano, bass, and the drum. I'm trying to say it. And they had one of them, what do you call them, homes? Sacks? No, no. Bass home. Bass home kind of thing. See, that was four, it's for the bass. And then the re-station was, there had two sacks. We had an alto, alto and that other, what, Marley Mercy blow? He blow, he played some piano. No, he played tenor. Tenor, I'm trying to say. We had first, second, you see, alto…
And it was different from New Orleans. Sure. Who would carry the melody the most of the time when the whole band was playing?
